title: Cloud Image Import Variables
description: Configuration variables for idempotent AWS AMI, Azure Managed Image / Compute Gallery VHD, and GCP Compute Engine image registration across package-as distro artifacts.

IMAGE_IMPORT_DRY_RUN.description: Flag (0 or 1) emitting cloud import descriptors without invoking live cloud APIs.

IMAGE_IMPORT_ARCH.description: Target CPU architecture registered on the imported cloud VM image.

IMAGE_IMPORT_AWS_BUCKET.description: Default Amazon S3 bucket used to stage disk snapshots prior to EC2 AMI registration.

IMAGE_IMPORT_AWS_REGION.description: Target AWS EC2 region for snapshot import and AMI registration.

IMAGE_IMPORT_GCP_BUCKET.description: Default Google Cloud Storage bucket used to stage disk.raw.tar.gz archives.

IMAGE_IMPORT_GCP_PROJECT.description: Target Google Cloud Platform project ID for GCE Compute Image registration.

IMAGE_IMPORT_AZURE_ACCOUNT.description: Default Azure Blob Storage account used for 1 MiB-aligned VHD PageBlob uploads.

IMAGE_IMPORT_AZURE_RG.description: Target Azure Resource Group for Managed Image and Compute Gallery resources.

IMAGE_IMPORT_AZURE_GALLERY.description: Optional Azure Compute Gallery (Shared Image Gallery) name; when empty, registers a standalone Azure Managed Image.
